data.name: Ariq
data.gender_notes: Ariq is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who rises in the sky like a shooting star, illuminating the path for others. The name Ariq carries the meaning “shooting star” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Ariq usually hope their child will grow to embody shooting star and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who are guided by the light of faith and inspire others on their spiritual journey.
data.etymology: Ariq belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “shooting star.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ariq total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: أريق
in_arabic.meaning: معنى الاسم أريق هو الشخص الذي يغذي
in_arabic.long_meaning: معنى الاسم أريق هو الشخص الذي يغذي ويربي الآخرين، ويأتي من الجذر العربي أَرَقَ، الذي يُشير إلى الفعل الذي يقوم به الشخص لتقديم العون والرعاية للآخرين، وله أهمية كبيرة في التراث الإسلامي حيث يشير إلى الشخص المتفاني في رعاية المسلمين

in_urdu.name: اریق
in_urdu.meaning: اریق کا معنی ہے دوسروں کی دیکھ بھال کرنے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: اریق کا معنی ہے دوسروں کی دیکھ بھال کرنے والا، اور یہ عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے جہاں اس کا مطلب ہے کہ دوسروں کی پرورش اور دیکھ بھال کرنا، اور اس کا重要 مقام ہے جنوبی ایشیائی مسلم روایت میں

in_hindi.name: अरीक
in_hindi.meaning: अरीक का अर्थ है दूसरों की देखभाल करने वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: अरीक का अर्थ है दूसरों की देखभाल करने वाला, और यह अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है जहां इसका अर्थ है दूसरों की परवरिश और देखभाल करना, और इसका महत्व है भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में

in_pashto.name: اریق
in_pashto.meaning: اریق د معنی دی چې د خپلو ملګرو پالنه کوونکی
in_pashto.long_meaning: اریق د معنی دی چې د خپلو ملګرو پالنه کوونکی، او دا کلمه د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوې ده چې د خپلو پالنې او دیکھ بھال کولو په معنی دی، او د افغان/پشتون دود کې یې ځانګړی اهمیت دی

in_english.name: Ariq

data.cultural_impact: The name Ariq, meaning "one who rises in the sky," carries a deep cultural significance in Islamic tradition. This name has roots in the mythological past, where Ariq Al-Jabali is mentioned as an ebony-skinned star in the constellation of Ursa Major, signifying the importance of guidance and rising above adversity. This name inspires a sense of courage, determination, and illuminating the path for others through leadership and guidance.
data.spiritual_significance: In a spiritual context, the name Ariq has profound implications for personal growth and seeking guidance from the divine. The term "rising in the sky" symbolizes a spiritual ascension, the ability to transcend earthly concerns and connect with a higher power. This connection allows for inner illumination, allowing the individual to become a beacon of light and guidance for those around them. Additionally, the Arabic root "raqaqa", found in the name, signifies protection and fortification, emphasizing the importance of seeking divine guidance and support during challenging times. Overall, the name Ariq serves as a powerful reminder of our potential to rise above hardship and become a source of guidance and light for others, while remaining steadfast in our connection with the divine.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Ariq in Arabic means "the one who leads or guides". Symbolically, it represents a person who illuminates the path for others through wisdom and knowledge. Spiritually, it signifies a devoted servant of Allah who guides others towards the righteous path and eternal salvation.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Ibn Kathir's Al-Bidayah wa'l-Nihayah, Volume 10, Page 378. Ariq ibn Anas, a companion of the Prophet (pbuh), was one of the first persons to accept Islam in Makkah. He was a member of the Quraysh tribe and played a significant role in the early spread of Islam in Makkah.
historical_references.context: Islamic history, Early Spread of Islam in Makkah

historical_references.reference: Al-Isabah fi Tamyiz Al-Sahabah by Ibn Hajar Al-Asqalani, Volume 3, Page 286. Ariq ibn Amir was a companion of the Prophet (pbuh) who was also known as 'Abdullah ibn Maslamah Al-Hilali. He participated in several battles, including Uhud and Hunayn.
historical_references.context: Islamic history, Military Campaigns of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh)
